title: CE60083: Structural Dynamics And Earthquake Engg.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Single and multiple degrees of freedom system, damped and undamped, numerical
integration schemes, modal analysis for undamped and damped systems. Wind and
earthquake forces, stationary, non stationary and random processes; behaviour
of chimneys, bridges and high rise buildings, structural ductility.
